Welding Log 24 checkpoints across 1 sections.Maintained from start of welding work (shop fabrication or field assembly) until final inspection and handover. Every joint created must be logged with execution, inspection, and approval details. Log updated daily or at shift completion. Serves as master audit trail of welding quality, inspection coverage, and final acceptance. Essential for warranty, quality claims, and future modifications. Download ExcelDownload PDF **24** Checkpoints **1** Sections Continuous; updated daily or after each joint completion; maintained from start to completion of all welding work Welding Inspector, QC Engineer [IS 816:1969](https://infralens.in/code/IS-816-1969) [IS 822:1970](https://infralens.in/code/IS-822-1970) [IS 814:2016](https://infralens.in/code/IS-814-Part-1-2004) Related [📐IS 816](https://infralens.in/code/IS-816) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Weld Sizes & Strength](https://infralens.in/handbook/weld-sizes-strength) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧steel-table](https://infralens.in/tools/steel-table) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | LOG. Welding Log — Column Definitions | | COL-01 | S.No
Acceptance: Sequential number starting from 1 for each welded joint entry; used for cross-referencing | Log entry sequence | | | COL-02 | Date
Acceptance: DD-MM-YYYY format; date when weld fully completed and cooled to handling temperature; not start date of welding | Welding execution date | | | COL-03 | Joint ID
Acceptance: Drawing-referenced joint ID (e.g., J-101, J-A2-15, etc.); must be unique within structure; links to structural drawing | Joint identification | | | COL-04 | Drawing Ref
Acceptance: Drawing number and revision (e.g., STD-001 Rev A) showing joint detail; links to weld schedule and specifications | Drawing documentation | | | COL-05 | Location
Acceptance: Description of location (e.g., 'Ground Floor, Column C-5 Base', 'Beam B-10 to Column C-7', 'North Face, Level 4', 'Footing to Pedestal'); enables field identification | Joint location on structure | | | COL-06 | Joint Type
Acceptance: Butt / Fillet / T-joint / Corner; must match drawing and WPS; determines inspection acceptance criteria and test requirements | Joint classification | | | COL-07 | Weld Process
Acceptance: SMAW (Shielded Metal Arc) / GMAW (Gas Metal Arc) / SAW (Submerged Arc) / FCAW (Flux Core Arc); must match WPS; process-specific quality criteria apply | Welding method | | | COL-08 | Welder ID
Acceptance: Welder's code/badge number or name; identifies who performed the weld; links to welder qualification certificate | Welder identification | | | COL-09 | Welder Qualification Ref
Acceptance: Certificate ID or reference (e.g., WELD-QIF-001, ASME D1.1-2015); confirms current qualification for process/position/material; valid period checked (typically 2-3 years) | Certification documentation | | | COL-10 | WPS Ref
Acceptance: WPS ID (e.g., WPS-STL-SMAW-001, WPS-STL-GMAW-002); confirms approved procedure for process/material/thickness/position; all welding done per approved WPS | Procedure specification | | | COL-11 | Electrode Type & Size
Acceptance: Classification and diameter (e.g., 'E7018 3.15 mm', 'SG2 1.2 mm wire', 'ER70S-2'); must match WPS; batch/lot number recorded for traceability | Filler metal specification | | | COL-12 | Parent Metal — Grade & Thickness
Acceptance: Grade (e.g., Fe 500D, E250) and thickness in mm; confirms material is suitable for welding process per WPS; links to material register | Base material documentation | | | COL-13 | Weld Length (mm)
Acceptance: Continuous weld length in mm as per drawing or job requirement; for fillet: theoretical length; for partial welds: actual length specified in drawing | Weld dimension | | | COL-14 | Visual Inspection Result
Acceptance: PASS if weld profile, size, undercut, porosity, cracks all acceptable per IS 816 Table 9; FAIL if any rejection criterion observed; HOLD if awaiting NDT | Visual examination outcome | | | COL-15 | Visual Inspector
Acceptance: Name or badge of visual inspector; establishes responsibility; typically site foreman or QC technician; certification required per project specs | Inspector identification | | | COL-16 | NDT Required
Acceptance: Y/N; 'Y' if drawing/project spec requires NDT (UT/RT/MPI/DPT); 'N' if visual-only acceptance permitted; percentage extent (e.g., 100%, 50%) noted in remarks if applicable | NDT decision | | | COL-17 | NDT Type
Acceptance: UT (Ultrasonic) / RT (Radiography) / MPI (Magnetic Particle) / DPT (Dye Penetrant); method selected per drawing, material, and joint accessibility | Non-destructive test method | | | COL-18 | NDT Report Ref
Acceptance: Report ID (e.g., UT-001-20260404, RT-002-20260404); links to detailed NDT findings and indications log; report filed with joint records | NDT documentation | | | COL-19 | NDT Result
Acceptance: PASS if no rejectable indications (cracks, large porosity, lack of fusion per IS 4260 / IS 1182); FAIL if rejectable defects found; PENDING if report awaited | NDT outcome | | | COL-20 | Repair Required
Acceptance: Y/N; 'Y' if visual or NDT failure requires repair; 'N' if joint accepted as-is; cross-reference to Repair Report if applicable | Defect disposition | | | COL-21 | Repair Report Ref
Acceptance: Repair report ID (e.g., REP-STL-001) if repair executed; includes defect description, repair WPS, re-inspection method and result; links to final acceptance | Repair documentation | | | COL-22 | Final Status
Acceptance: ACCEPTED if visual + dimensional + NDT all pass (or repair re-inspection passes); REJECTED if defects cannot be repaired or exceed concession limits; CONDITIONAL if subject to concession/waiver | Joint acceptance decision | | | COL-23 | QC Engineer
Acceptance: Name of QC Engineer approving joint; establishes responsibility for acceptance decision; must be authorized inspecting authority per project | QC approval authority | | | COL-24 | Remarks
Acceptance: Any deviations, special conditions, site constraints (e.g., 'Weather protected by tent', 'Field weld due to shop damage', 'Concession approved by PM on 03-04-2026', 'Repair completed 04-04-2026'); links to NCR or CAR if applicable | Additional notes | | LOG. identification (Unique welder code) ✓ Welder's code/badge number or name; identifies who performed the weld; links to welder qualification certificate COL-09Welder Qualification Ref Certification Continuous weld length in mm as per drawing or job requirement; for fillet: theoretical length; for partial welds: actual length specified in drawing COL-14Visual Inspection Result Visual examination outcome (First-level inspection per IS 822:1970) ✓ PASS if weld profile, size, undercut, porosity, cracks all acceptable per IS 816 Table 9; FAIL if any rejection criterion observed; HOLD if awaiting NDT COL-15Visual Inspector Inspector identification (Inspector name/ID) ✓ Name or badge of visual inspector; establishes responsibility; typically site foreman or QC technician; certification required per project specs COL-16NDT Required NDT decision (Project specification requirement) ✓ Y/N; 'Y' if drawing/project spec requires NDT (UT/RT/MPI/DPT); 'N' if visual-only acceptance permitted; percentage extent (e.g., 100%, 50%) noted in remarks if applicable COL-17NDT Type Non-destructive test method (Method selection) ✓ UT (Ultrasonic) / RT (Radiography) / MPI (Magnetic Particle) / DPT (Dye Penetrant); method selected per drawing, material, and joint accessibility COL-18NDT Report Ref NDT documentation (Test report number) ✓ Report ID (e.g., UT-001-20260404, RT-002-20260404); links to detailed NDT findings and indications log; report filed with joint records COL-19NDT Result NDT outcome (Test acceptance per IS standards) ✓ PASS if no rejectable indications (cracks, large porosity, lack of fusion per IS 4260 / IS 1182); FAIL if rejectable defects found; PENDING if report awaited COL-20Repair Required Defect disposition (Corrective action) ✓ Y/N; 'Y' if visual or NDT failure requires repair; 'N' if joint accepted as-is; cross-reference to Repair Report if applicable COL-21Repair Report Ref Repair documentation (Corrective action record) ✓ Repair report ID (e.g., REP-STL-001) if repair executed; includes defect description, repair WPS, re-inspection method and result; links to final acceptance COL-22Final Status Joint acceptance decision (Final disposition) ✓ ACCEPTED if visual + dimensional + NDT all pass (or repair re-inspection passes); REJECTED if defects cannot be repaired or exceed concession limits; CONDITIONAL if subject to concession/waiver COL-23QC Engineer QC approval authority (Approval signature) ✓ Name of QC Engineer approving joint; establishes responsibility for acceptance decision; must be authorized inspecting authority per project COL-24Remarks Additional notes (Miscellaneous observations) ✓ Any deviations, special conditions, site constraints (e.g., 'Weather protected by tent', 'Field weld due to shop damage', 'Concession approved by PM on 03-04-2026', 'Repair completed 04-04-2026'); links to NCR or CAR if applicable Inspection Sign-Off WELDING COMPLETE: All joints logged, inspected, and disposition documented PENDING: Welding ongoing; final count and summary to be updated FINAL SUMMARY: All joints completed, inspected, and accepted (or repaired and re-accepted) Total Joints Welded Name / Sign /
